about_the_game:
G.M.M (Guerrier Mages and Metamorphes) is a turn-based 2D RPG.

Game controle

The game can be play only with keyboard

A : talk, do actions

direction key : to move

TAB : open menu

Z : cancel action (in fight)

Story

Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman and his mage friend Vard.

During one of their mission, they will encounter a metamorph of the wolf clan with serious wound.

But by helping him, they will put themself into a major conflict between several country.

  • Travel the world to gain new allies.

  • Level up your allies to learn new techniques.

  • Fight enemies in turn-based battles
